summary: Real 10-year yields pushed toward the top of their recent range and the dollar index held above its 30-day average Thursday, keeping pressure on gold even as calm volatility left equities range-bound. Narrow participation, with the average stock lagging the S&P, kept breadth thin beneath a still-orderly surface.
tweet: Firmer real yields and a stronger dollar weighed on gold Thursday while low volatility masked thin, narrow-breadth equity gains.
